Insurance relative strength remains notable: ACGL fell just 0.72% versus XLF down 7.00% and SPY down 8.56% over the same span, while its StockLens technical reading remains strong; price closed 0.49% below VWAP, so wait for renewed buying.

sector_notes: Risk-off remains severe: on Nov 20 the S&P 500 fell 3.7% and Nasdaq 5.3%, while Massive's Nov 13-20 closes show SPY down 8.56% and QQQ down 10.51%; among U.S. tickers priced at least $5 with at least 500,000 shares traded, decliners led advancers 2,528 to 570. Consumer staples were the clearest relative leader, with XLP down 2.05% over the same span versus SPY down 8.56%, followed by utilities down 3.07%; technology was the weakest major sector at down 12.49%, and semiconductors suffered the sharpest losses. The regime favors selective defensive relative strength and reduced gross exposure, not aggressive momentum chasing, until breadth and price/volume stabilize.
